title: Zesty French Potato Tartiflette
description: A spicy and flavorful French dish featuring seasoned rice vinegar and vegetarian friendly ingredients, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware cook and served on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, seasoned rice vinegar, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and toss to coat.
Transfer the potato mixture to a ttukbaegi earthenware cook and top with the crumbly reeblochon cheese.
Cover the earthenware cook with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove the tartiflette from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh thyme.
Serve the tartiflette hot on a hot stone plate.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
